title: Affine etale rank-one extensions separate module-valued sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. In the category of sheaves valued in $\mathrm{Mod}(\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], the family $G_U=j_{U!}\underline{\Lambda}_U$, indexed by all affine objects $j_U:U\to X$ of this site, is separating: for every $f,g:F\to F^{\prime}$, if $f\circ h=g\circ h$ for every $U$ and every $h:G_U\to F$, then $f=g$. Here extension by zero is [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] and the constant sheaf is [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. The site, index family, coefficients and Hom sets use universe $u+1$ above the base-scheme universe $u$. No quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness or finiteness of the ring is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03EW, proof of (3), detection by the maps associated to sections; Tag 04HR in topologies.tex, cover density of affine etale objects. This is step 1 of lem-weil-pbc-constructible-generation in the ModuleCat-valued formulation.

proof.text: For each affine etale U, compose the constant-sheaf/terminal-evaluation adjunction with etaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction transported along upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction. This identifies maps from the rank-one extension to F with linear maps from Lambda to F(U), naturally in F. The localized terminal object maps to U (proved by ext and rfl).

If f and g agree after all maps from the rank-one extension at U, apply this Hom equivalence to the inverse image of each linear map Lambda -> F(U). Naturality yields a composed equality. Use the linear map r |-> r*x and evaluate at 1 to obtain f_U(x)=g_U(x), for every x. ModuleCat.hom_ext gives equality of components.

The Spec functor from the affine etale site is cover-dense and full, by the affine-etale Mathlib leaf. Mathlib Functor.whiskerLeft_obj_map_bijective_of_isCoverDense makes restriction of morphisms into a sheaf injective. The preceding equality holds on all its affine source objects, so restriction of f and g agrees. Injectivity and Sheaf.hom_ext prove f=g.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_etale_rankOne_isSeparating
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] :
    ObjectProperty.IsSeparating (ObjectProperty.ofObj
      (C := Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (fun U : { U : X.Etale // IsAffine U.left } ↦
        (Etale.etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.val.hom inferInstance).obj
          ((constantSheaf U.val.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of Λ Λ))))
